steps.sub: new device broadcasts for any DHCP server

steps.label: Request

steps.label: Lease
steps.sub: address is borrowed for a set time, then renewed

steps.label: Expired, unrenewed
steps.sub: address returns to the pool for reuse

steps.label: Reservation
steps.sub: same address every time, tied to a MAC address
